Flag neurons seeded more than once

octo_flag_duplicates.Rd

Rows with the same root ID are the same neuron. In each such group exactly one row should be the trusted ("primary") row; the others are "secondary".

Usage

octo_flag_duplicates(root, primary, ctime, pos, info = rep(0L, length(root)))

Arguments

root

root IDs (character)

primary

logical, rows currently marked primary

ctime

creation time (anything that sorts correctly, e.g. ISO strings)

pos

label of each row, used in same_as (e.g. the position)

info

number of filled annotation fields per row

Value

data.frame with n_seeds, status, primary, same_as

Details

  • no row marked primary: the row with the most information (info) becomes primary, ties go to the oldest (ctime); status "primary (auto)"

  • one row marked: status "primary", the others "secondary"

  • several marked: "CONFLICT: n primaries", usually because proofreading merged two neurons that were both annotated

  • root ID "0" or empty: "no segment"
